description: The REFUSAL to RENAME an index to a name longer than 28 characters: both platforms silently truncate the name (measured on 2026-09-23: 'IX_Contact_Email_Name_Status30' became 'IX_Contact_Email_Name_Status'). In `create` the kernel writes the name that Studio keeps and reports it in nameTruncations (D2, frictions 3); in `rename` the name is an explicit choice of the author and the kernel refuses, giving the name the platform would use.
